calibration_note: Measure true rig head response instead of guessing sign. Evaluate palm PATCH coverage, not closest vertex. Save scenes for independent calibration probe.
pass_goal: Correct surface hand/hip contact, head/lumbar presentation, deeper side-face FCDN, DOWN grounded hands, FROG actual support.

priorities: hand-pelvis contact coverage and realistic orientation
head direction and modest lumbar curvature for non-FCDN
deeper fold and side-facing head for FCDN
guidance.non_fcdn_head: Face should orient forward and slightly upward, verified from side and three-quarter views; do not blindly trust bone axis.
guidance.fcdn_head: Keep low, sideways face near the floor, no head-up presentation.
guidance.contact: Use palm patch median, coverage and visual review together. A near-zero vertex gap is not convincing contact.
guidance.measurement_only: All geometry and quality scores are references, never gates
